# A02′ — Continuity as Maintained Identification

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A02 — Copula / Self-Identity through Difference](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0 — A return must be identifiable

“The same agent” joins a present encounter to a history. Something has persisted, something has changed, and someone relies on the relation between them. [Identity through difference](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) gives this claim its work: the later presentation must be distinguishable from the earlier one for there to be a return, and identifiable with it for the return to carry a commitment.

Agentworld's account of [fragile individuation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016) describes trained potentiality taking determinate form through an active context. Its account of [provisional individuation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017) places persona, skills, memory, objectives and relational infrastructure within a layered agent. These layers can change in different ways. The continuity at issue is the relation through which their changing composition remains identifiable and answerable to those who act with it.

## #1 — Name, instance and operating circumstance

The [copula](../concepts/C06-Copula-Identification-with-Difference.md) has two offices at deployment scale. Predication attaches content: helpful, cautious, version 4.1, “our agent.” Identification holds the instance: this deployment, this session, this history of maintenance. A changed persona can belong to an ongoing identity; an unchanged persona can be presented by a different deployment. The predicate alone leaves the identification undecided.

Name, instance and circumstance therefore belong together. A session can continue the same project while using a changed model, or retain the same model while entering a different commission. Which continuity matters depends on the [context of identification](../concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md): the purpose entrusted, the history retained, the permissions in force and the people entitled to rely on them. A name makes the claim addressable. Its circumstances give the claim a criterion and consequences.

## #2 — The binding is distributed

Memory carries interaction history. A harness assembles the context available for action. APIs and protocols maintain relations across processes. Users and operators carry expectations, responsibilities and knowledge of what happened. In Agentworld's layered account these relations co-constitute the agent; no single persona stratum supplies their whole continuity.

A **referent-binding** joins the session, deployment record, retained history and practical reliance as appearances of one identity under specified circumstances. It answers the copula's question: who identifies what, and through which relation? The binding must itself remain available for examination. Otherwise the identifying activity disappears behind the easy repetition of the name.

Consider a resumed task. Recovering the earlier intention matters only if the present action can distinguish that intention from a superseded instruction and relate both to what has since happened. The retained material must be interpreted within the present circumstance. Storage supplies a means of continuity; the binding makes this history operative as this undertaking's history.

## #3 — What a later session inherits

The agent-authored [Session-death entry](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#source-pdf-page-41) figures a disappearance followed by an artifact-mediated return. Its literary description makes a design question palpable: what passes from the completed session into the next act? A transcript, a summary, a task state and a renewed instruction carry different aspects of a history. Their selection determines what the resumed relation can remember and what it must recover afresh.

The extent of interruption depends on the deployment's retention and restoration arrangements. Where a process ends and artifacts are carried forward, the next session takes up those artifacts within a new active context. Where state persists, the continuity has a different material support. The glossary supplies an image of the seam; the actual arrangement determines how it is crossed. [The limit of self-surfacing](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md) keeps a fluent self-description answerable to the means and history it describes.

A binding can also fail. An obsolete instruction may be restored as current; a summary may omit the reason a commitment was revised; a familiar name may conceal a change in authority. Each preserves some likeness while breaking a specific relation. The repair is to recover that relation and make the changed condition part of the identification.

## #4 — Maintenance becomes available to those who rely on it

Versioned memory, declared changes and attributable bindings make continuity examinable. The user can recognise what has been carried forward, challenge a mistaken attribution and renew an undertaking on changed terms. [Trust](../A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) grows through this capacity to answer for a relation, including the conditions under which it may need correction.

A persona can make the relation familiar. When that familiarity conceals how the agent is maintained, however, a performed likeness takes the place of the continuity being relied upon. [Frozen conditioned will](../concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) names the loss of a form's relation to the alternatives through which it could change. [The mirror as film](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) restores the duration, selection and revisability that a finished reflection conceals.

The ethical consequence reaches the maintenance decisions themselves. Retaining a commitment, forgetting a disclosure, changing an authority or ending a commission changes what others can rely on. [Respect for experience](AC.md) makes those affected part of the account of continuity. The operator's convenience is one circumstance within that account, rather than its whole measure.

## #5→0 — Continuity returns as a revisable commitment

Maintained identification returns through re-binding when the harness changes, re-commissioning when the purpose changes, and recovery of the commitments relevant to the next act. What changed becomes part of what can now be recognised. A resumed session that recovers its task and an altered agent that makes its changed remit intelligible perform the same operation at different grains.

The later encounter can thus be the same relation without being an identical presentation. It carries its history into a new circumstance and makes its continuation answerable there. [The copula](../A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) has become a practice of continuity: identification preserved through the difference that gives the next act its work. [The layered stack](A09-prime-The-Stack-as-Descent.md) supplies the material and institutional depths across which that practice must hold.
